text:
elaine: Quick sync — we need final copy + assets for the 4/8 webinar posts across X and LinkedIn. Primary ask: a short launch post, a follow-up thread for X, and a LinkedIn carousel. Also need benchmark narrative blurb for the blog link and routing for inbound signups (SDR handoff).

devon: ETA for assets? creative said they can turn around GIF + carousel by EOD Friday if we lock copy today.

ryan: sending a tiny doc with proposed CTAs — prefer 2 variants (Demo vs. Watch Now). Which do we want to A/B for paid promos?

elaine: good q. let's A/B the CTA on paid; organic posts default to "Watch the replay". Paid gets split demo vs watch. matt_sdr can you own post-signup routing?

matt_sdr: yep i got routing. +1 on A/B. For signups: add hidden utm=webinar_apr08_variantA/B and route variantA to SDR queue "Growth" variantB to "Enterprise" so we can measure quality. share example form field we should capture?

elaine: keep form minimal: name, email, company, role, company_size (dropdown), optional notes. matt_sdr will pick up within 30m for Growth and 4h for Enterprise.

natalie: copy note: benchmark blurb needs one aggressive stat line + context sentence. proposed: "Our internal benchmark shows 2–3x latency reduction for 90th percentile inference using Redwood Optimize compared to default serving. Hear the full test & config on 4/8." Thoughts?

devon: that hits. maybe change "internal" -> "real-world" to read better for marketing.

ryan: URL / blog post draft: https://redwood.example.com/blog/optimize-benchmarks-apr08 — use that for all linkbacks. I'll append utm params: ?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=april_webinar&utm_medium=organic&variant={{variant}}

elaine: perfect. creative deliverables checklist: GIF (16:9, <2MB), LinkedIn carousel (3 slides, 1200x1200), X thread images (1200x675), short caption variants (90 chars & 220 chars). devon/natalie confirm.

natalie: confirmed. i'll draft caption variants and share in thread.

ryan: scheduling plan (quick):
```
Channel,Post Type,Date,Time,CTA,UTM Variant
X,Teaser,2026-04-06,11:00am,Watch Now,organic
LinkedIn,Carousel,2026-04-07,9:00am,Watch Now,organic
X,Thread (promo),2026-04-08,30m before start,Watch Now,organic
Paid X,Single image,2026-04-08,10:30am,Demo/Watch Now,variantA/B
LinkedIn,Post (replay),2026-04-09,2:00pm,Watch the replay,organic
```

elaine: nice. can social_scheduler_bot queue those? @social_scheduler_bot pls confirm scheduling slots open.

social_scheduler_bot: Slots available. Queued drafts for 2026-04-06 -> 2026-04-09. Will post at scheduled times. Reminder set for creative asset attach by 2026-04-04 5:00pm PT. :robot_face: 

devon: one more — who will own the X thread live moderation (answering Qs)? I can do first hour, matt_sdr will pick up lead follow-up.

matt_sdr: i'll monitor DMs and follow up with named leads. please tag with #lead-follow in thread replies.

natalie: attaching caption drafts (pasted below). Variant A (short): "How we cut 90th-pct inference time by 2–3x — join our 4/8 webinar to see configs + benchmarks. Register: https://redwood.example.com/blog/optimize-benchmarks-apr08?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=april_webinar&variant=A"

Variant B (long): "Benchmarks matter: we compared default serving vs. Redwood Optimize across real workloads and saw 2–3x better 90th percentile latency. We'll walk through test harness, kernel choices, and cost tradeoffs on 4/8. Register & get the spreadsheet: https://redwood.example.com/blog/optimize-benchmarks-apr08?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=april_webinar&variant=B"

elaine: love both. devon pls pair short for X, long for LinkedIn. Also request: creative please include a slide with "what you’ll learn" bullet list and a single-sentence speaker bio.

devon: calling out need for speaker headshots — @ryan can you drop high-res headshots?

ryan: uploaded to drive: https://drive.example.com/shotpack/optimize_4_8 (images: ryan_head.jpg, jo_head.jpg).

elaine: timeline recap: lock copy by EOD today (4/1), creative to deliver assets by 4/4 EOD, scheduler queues for 4/6–4/9. matt_sdr will confirm routing setup and test form by 4/3. social will A/B paid CTA.

matt_sdr: i'll run a quick signup test once form has utm variants live. ping me when drafts are queued.

devon: i'll post final caption + attach files here once creative delivers. :thumbsup: 

elaine: great — thanks everyone. i'll follow up if anything changes. :raised_hands:
